prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a giraffe version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: Create a square reaction sticker of a chubby baby giraffe caught mid-belly-laugh. Give it a huge round golden-yellow head, a short upright giraffe neck, a plump pear-shaped body, two tiny brown-tipped ossicones, wide rounded ears, and a few caramel-brown patches. Show it from the front with its head tipped back, shoulders raised, and both little hooves curled against its belly. Squeeze its eyes into thin upward crescents and push its cheeks up around an comically oversized, wide-open grin that takes up most of the lower face. Inside the mouth, show a broad row of white upper teeth, a deep reddish interior, and a little pink tongue. Make the expression feel like one frozen frame of a loud, uncontrollable cackle. Use smooth, softly shaded 3D cartoon shapes, a centered full-body crop, and a plain white background with no text.
